meta.promptText: India mein oily skin ke liye 500 rupees ke andar konsa face wash kharidna chahiye?

response.text:
India mein **oily skin** ke liye ₹500 ke andar sabse safe aur useful choice usually **salicylic acid-based** ya **oil-control gel cleanser** hoti hai, kyunki ye extra sebum aur clogged pores ko target karti hai.[2][6]

**Mere top picks:**
- **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Face Wash** — acne-prone oily skin ke liye strong option; NDTV Shopping aur iDiva type roundups mein ye under ₹500 category mein recommend kiya gaya hai.[6][1]
- **The Derma Co 2% Niacinamide Oily Skin Cleanser** — oily skin aur inflammation ko calm karne ke liye achha option, especially agar breakouts bhi hote hain.[6]
- **Plum Green Tea Pore Cleansing Face Wash** — oily skin ke liye balanced option; simple skincare roundup mein isko “best overall” bola gaya hai.[4]
- **Garnier Pure Active Neem Face Wash** — sabse budget-friendly type option, agar aap basic oil control chahte ho.[4]
- **Simple Kind to Skin Refreshing Facial Wash** — agar aapki skin oily hone ke saath sensitive bhi hai, to ye gentler choice ho sakti hai.[4]

**Agar ek hi product choose karna ho:**
- **Acne/blackheads hain:** **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Face Wash**.[6][4]
- **Normal oily skin hai, breakout kam hain:** **Plum Green Tea Face Wash**.[4]
- **Sensitive oily skin hai:** **Simple Refreshing Facial Wash**.[4]
- **Sirf budget chahiye:** **Garnier Neem Face Wash**.[4]

**Kya avoid karein:**
- Bahut harsh, over-drying face washes, kyunki oily skin ko bhi barrier damage ho sakta hai; gel-based, foam-based, aur oil-controlling ingredients jaise salicylic acid, neem, green tea, ya niacinamide zyada suitable bataye gaye hain.[4]

Agar aap chaho, main ₹500 ke andar **best 3 face washes ka exact shortlist** bhi bana deta hoon — *acne-prone*, *sensitive*, aur *value for money* category mein.
